questions.stem: A 70-year-old male was suffering from motion sickness. He came to the physician because he has to travel the next day to a hilly station. The physician asked him to take a hyoscine to control his symptoms. Hyoscine is a weak base. Which of the following site does the hyoscine get absorbed?
questions.solutionHtml:
Small intestine


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:17

questions.stem: A patient was prescribed a drug with a pKa of 5 and the drug reaches the medium with a pH of 5. Which of the following is TRUE?
questions.solutionHtml:
50% ionized and 50% un-ionized
